spotify.show_song: Only API returning play_count, rating, like_count, release_date, duration, genre (string) and artists for a song. Takes song_id only: do NOT pass access_token. release_date is an ISO datetime (year = first 4 chars); duration is in SECONDS. artists is a list of {id, name}. Cache per song.
spotify.show_song_privates: Returns only per-user flags (liked, reviewed, in_song_library, downloaded). No play_count/rating/release_date: use show_song for those.
spotify.show_album: No access_token parameter. Its songs list uses key 'id' (not 'song_id'). Library album items carry song_ids.
spotify.show_playlist_library: Lists MY playlists only. Each item has playlist_id and song_ids. page_limit default 5 (max 20): loop page_index until empty. Use this, not search_playlists, to find my playlist.
spotify.show_song_library: Items use key song_id. Default page_limit 5 (max 20): loop all pages. Songs may also be in library albums/playlists (song_ids) or liked songs: union them if the task says 'in my library'.
spotify.show_liked_songs: Items use key song_id and liked_at. Default page_limit 5 (max 20): loop all pages.
phone.login: The username is the PHONE NUMBER from supervisor.show_profile (not the email); password from supervisor.show_account_passwords.
phone.search_contacts: Default page_limit 5 (max 20): loop page_index until empty. Use relationship='sister' etc. (see show_contact_relationships); a contact may have several relationship labels.
venmo.create_payment_request: Params: user_email (the other person's email), amount, access_token, description, private. It requests money; create_payment (send money) is a different API.
venmo.show_transactions: Filters: query, user_email, min_created_at/max_created_at (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive), min/max_amount, direction ('sent' or 'received'; there is no show_sent_transactions API). Loop all pages. Items: transaction_id, amount, sender/receiver {name,email}, created_at. For totals, sum the real items in the window.
supervisor.complete_task: Question tasks: pass answer=<minimal value>. Action tasks (play, add, send, delete, request, like...): call with NO answer, even if you computed something.
spotify.show_song_queue: Needs access_token. Not paginated. Items: song_id, position, is_current, is_playing; 'played so far incl. current' = items from position 0 through the is_current item.
spotify.search_songs: Public search: do NOT pass access_token. Paginated (default 5, max 20): loop page_index until empty.
spotify.like_song: Requires access_token (a 401 is silent if you swallow errors). Liking an already-liked song gives a benign 422.
phone.get_current_date_and_time: Takes NO parameters (no access_token). Returns {'date': 'Thursday, May 18, 2023', 'time': ...}; parse with strptime('%A, %B %d, %Y'). The app date, not the real date.
phone.send_text_message: Params: phone_number, message, access_token. Do not re-run a cell that already created something when a later call fails.
venmo.show_received_payment_requests: No status field in items: pending means approved_at and denied_at are both None. Items have payment_request_id, sender/receiver objects with email. Default page_limit 5 (max 20): loop all pages.
venmo.show_sent_payment_requests: No status field in items: pending means approved_at and denied_at are both None. Items have payment_request_id, sender/receiver objects with email. Default page_limit 5 (max 20): loop all pages.
file_system.show_directory: Params: access_token, directory_path, recursive, entry_type ('all'|'files'|'directories'), substring. Returns ABSOLUTE path strings (dirs end '/'): use as returned. Use recursive=True unless the task says top level only; 0 results usually means a wrong path/flag (list_paths() raises on empty).
file_system.move_file: Params: source_file_path, destination_file_path (full final path incl. new name), access_token, overwrite (keep False), retain_dates (default False RESETS created_at to now: pass True, and read all created_at values BEFORE moving). Rename = move to the new name. Check every response.
phone.search_text_messages: Items: message (text; NOT 'content'), sent_at, sender/receiver objects {name, phone_number}. Order is not guaranteed: sort by sent_at. Use phone_number= for a person; query= searches the body only (can hide the reply you need). Default page_limit 5 (max 20). read_thread() prints a whole thread.
phone.search_voice_messages: Use phone_number= for a person's number; query= searches the body only. Default page_limit 5 (max 20). Delete takes voice_message_id.
venmo.search_users: Fuzzy: returns up to 5 near matches, not just exact ones. Compare result email to the exact email before concluding someone has an account. Searching by phone number is unsupported.
spotify.show_playlist: Private playlists need access_token. Detail response lists songs under 'songs', each with key 'id' (NOT song_id); library list items carry song_ids instead. Playlist songs may not be in the song library: judge them by their own show_song data.
spotify.review_song: Params: song_id, rating (int), access_token, optional title/text. One review per user per song: a 409 means one exists. Use upsert_review(...) or find it via show_song_reviews(song_id, user_email=<my email>) and call update_song_review(review_id=<its song_review_id>, ...).
spotify.show_artist: Public (no access_token). Gives follower_count, genres, etc. Artist objects embedded in songs/albums have only 'id' and 'name'; match artists by id.
spotify.play_music: Needs access_token. Pass AT MOST ONE of song_id, album_id, playlist_id, queue_position. To end with the right collection, play the container, then play_music(queue_position=<target's position>) (play_in_container() does this and checks). Verify with show_current_song(access_token=...).
venmo.create_transaction: Params: receiver_email, amount, access_token, description, private, payment_card_id (optional: pay from a card when the balance is too low). Do NOT top up with add_to_venmo_balance first (creates extra bank-transfer records). Take the receiver's email from the contact.
venmo.show_social_feed: Friends' transactions, paginated (default 5, max 20): loop page_index until an empty page. Items hold sender/receiver objects and created_at; filter by date with the created_at field.
spotify.show_downloaded_songs: Items use key song_id. Default page_limit 5 (max 20): loop all pages. Song details (rating, play_count...) come from show_song.
phone.show_alarms: Paginated: default page_limit 5 (max 20); exactly 5 results means INCOMPLETE, use fetch_all_pages. Print every label and match on norm_text with '-', '_' and spaces unified (labels may be formatted differently from the task wording). Update/delete one alarm per call by alarm_id.
venmo.show_payment_cards: NOT paginated (no page_limit). Fields: payment_card_id, card_name, expiry_year, expiry_month, card_number (no brand/last_four). Some cards are expired or lack funds: use live_cards() then first_success() with create_transaction(payment_card_id=...). add_payment_card with invented numbers always fails.
venmo.add_to_venmo_balance: Needs payment_card_id (no description param) and creates a bank-transfer record that counts as collateral damage. Prefer create_transaction(payment_card_id=...) from a card that works.
venmo.like_transaction: Takes transaction_id + access_token. Items from show_transactions have sender/receiver objects {name, email}; there is NO 'direction' field on an item. Already-liked gives a 422 that is benign.
simple_note.search_notes: Fuzzy/keyword search: may return a different note first. Pick the note by exact title from the full list (fetch_all_pages), then show_note for its content; print the content before parsing it.
file_system.show_file: Returns content under 'content' plus file_id, path, created_at, updated_at (no 'name'). For bills, take year/month from the file name (YYYY-MM.txt) and category from the parent folder; read one format per month (.txt) and the labelled total line.
spotify.show_current_song: Needs access_token (401 without it). Flat dict: song_id, title, top-level `artists` list of {id, name}, album info, is_playing. To test 'song by artist X' compare X's id against [a['id'] for a in cur['artists']]. An error/None means nothing is playing: do not complete_task.
spotify.search_artists: Fuzzy name search; also genre, min_follower_count filters. Public (no token). Items: artist_id (NOT id), name, genre, follower_count. (Artists embedded in songs/albums use 'id'.) Re-filter on the exact name/genre string; print the list size.
spotify.show_song_reviews: Public lookup (no token). user_email=<my email> gives MY review of a song. Items: song_review_id (NOT review_id), rating (int), title, text. The update/delete calls take that value as their `review_id` argument. show_song's rating is the global average, not mine. upsert_review() does find-or-create.
spotify.next_song: Moves the cursor one song forward and returns the new current song info; for 'keep going until X' loop it with a cap, re-check show_current_song after each skip, and stop on the first match (do not skip past it).
file_system.compress_directory: Params: directory_path, compressed_file_path (ends .zip), delete_directory (True removes the source in the same call), overwrite. One call per directory; re-list afterwards to confirm archives exist and sources are gone.
spotify.show_recommendations: Needs access_token and is PAGINATED (default 5, max 20): loop page_index until empty (fetch_all_pages) before counting or ranking. Items use key song_id, with artists [{id,name}].
spotify.show_liked_albums: Liked albums (needs access_token, paginated: loop all pages). An album counts as 'downloaded' only if ALL its song ids are in show_downloaded_songs; 'liked or downloaded' album = liked OR fully downloaded.
spotify.show_artist_following: Returns {'following': bool} (key is 'following', not 'is_following'). Verify follows with a read call and treat 0 follows as failure.
venmo.remind_payment_request: Only works on payment requests YOU SENT (list them with show_sent_payment_requests; the receiver is the other person). On requests you received it returns 422 'not authorized to remind'.
spotify.update_song_review: Params: review_id (= the item's song_review_id from show_song_reviews), access_token, optional rating/title/text. Pass only the fields that change.
spotify.delete_account: Deletes the account (needs access_token). 'Delete / terminate / close my account' means THIS call; logout only ends the session and leaves the account in place.
spotify.show_album_library: Only albums I saved (needs access_token, paginated: loop all pages). Items: album_id, title, song_ids. If the named album is not here, use the public search_albums (exact title match) and take its song_ids; print the match.
file_system.create_file: Params: file_path (full path incl. file name), access_token, content, overwrite. Use the exact path/name the task gives. There is no make_directory: use create_directory(directory_path=..., access_token, recursive) first if the folder is new.
file_system.create_directory: Params: directory_path, access_token, recursive, allow_if_exists. Parameter is directory_path (NOT path).
file_system.delete_file: Params: file_path, access_token. Delete only files the task names; re-list the folder afterwards to confirm.
file_system.delete_directory: Params: directory_path, access_token. Deletes the folder with ALL its contents; use only when the task asks for the folder itself to go.
